identification: Three containers of mostly common circulated coins. (1) Red-lined carved wooden box: modern world coins, mostly cupronickel and aluminium-bronze (photo 1, nothing readable). (2) Plastic tub: Australian KGV/KGVI pennies (dates readable 1913, 1917, 192x, 1938-64 kangaroo type), GB Elizabeth II Tudor-rose florins (1953+, cupronickel), one George VI florin with IND IMP (1937-48: silver .500 only if 1946 or earlier), a holed pewter/white-metal medal with seated figure and partial legend '...FILS AND...' (date ends 18x7?), a small worn green bronze animal figure, gilt lapel pins and cufflinks, a '91' badge, one white chert knapped point (looks a genuine arrowhead/point type, origin unknown) plus several rough jasper/agate/chert rock pieces that look like specimens not artefacts. (3) Green shoebox: 1953 QEII Coronation crown (cupronickel), 1970 Captain Cook bicentenary medallions/coins, Australian 1936 halfpenny, GB Victorian/Edwardian bun and veiled-head pennies (worn), decimal UK new pence, NZ 2c, other world coins. Estimate A$20-30, current bid A$15.
